Therefore, this is not necessarily true.\n    14\t\n    15\t(b) The orthogonal projection of A onto plane BCD coincides with the incenter of triangle BCD.\n    16\t\n    17\tCounterexample: Similar to (a), the volume condition doesn't guarantee that the projection of A onto BCD is the incenter of BCD. Therefore, this is not necessarily true.\n    48\t\n    49\t(f) AB = AC = AD.\n    50\t\n    51\tCounterexample: The volume condition does not imply that AB = AC = AD.
